views.name: matches_with_scores_and_league
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "match_api_id",
  "id",
  "season",
  "league_id",
  "home_team_goal",
  "away_team_goal",
  "date"
FROM "Match"
views.description: One row per match including its league linkage and raw goal counts. Exposes match identifiers, season, league id, and both teams' goals so callers can filter by season and aggregate goals by league.

views.name: league_catalog
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS "id as league_id",
  League.name AS "name as league_name",
  League.country_id
FROM League
views.description: Canonical list of leagues with their ids and names. Useful to join league metadata (name) to aggregated match-level metrics.

views.name: league_goals_aggregation_candidates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(m.home_team_goal, 0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal, 0)
  ) AS total_goals,
  COUNT(m.id) AS match_count
FROM
  matches_with_scores_and_league AS m
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Per-league, per-season raw aggregation candidates: exposes the sum of home and away goals and match counts per (league_id, season). Does not apply season literal so it can be reused for any season-level analysis.

views.name: matches_with_league_and_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_api_id,
  m.id,
  m.league_id,
  m.season,
  m.date,
  m.home_team_api_id,
  m.away_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal
FROM "Match" AS m
views.description: One row per match with essential match outcomes and league/season identifiers to filter cohorts by league and season.

views.name: team_id_name_map
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  team_long_name,
  team_short_name,
  id
FROM Team
views.description: Canonical mapping of team API id to team long and short names for joining team identifiers to readable names.

views.name: league_id_name_map
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS "id as league_id",
  League.name AS "name as league_name",
  League.country_id AS country_id
FROM League
views.description: Mapping of league id to league name (and country_id) to enable filtering matches by league name.

views.name: team_attributes_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  team_api_id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  date,
  buildUpPlaySpeed,
  buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
  buildUpPlayDribbling,
  buildUpPlayDribblingClass,
  buildUpPlayPassing,
  buildUpPlayPassingClass,
  buildUpPlayPositioningClass,
  chanceCreationPassing,
  chanceCreationPassingClass,
  chanceCreationCrossing,
  chanceCreationCrossingClass,
  chanceCreationShooting,
  chanceCreationShootingClass,
  defencePressure,
  defencePressureClass,
  defenceAggression,
  defenceAggressionClass,
  defenceTeamWidth,
  defenceTeamWidthClass,
  defenceDefenderLineClass
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
grain: Team_Attributes.id  -- one row per Team_Attributes record
views.description: One row per Team_Attributes record exposing team identifiers, timestamp and raw numeric/team-playstyle measures. Keeps each attribute row separate (no aggregation) so queries can rank/sort per-record.

views.name: team_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_api_id,
  team_fifa_api_id,
  team_long_name,
  team_short_name,
  id
FROM Team
grain: Team.team_api_id  -- one row per team (team identity)
views.description: Canonical team identity table with primary ids and canonical display name. Useful to join team attributes to human-friendly names. Exposes both api and fifa ids and long/short names.

views.name: team_attributes_with_team_name
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Team_Attributes.team_api_id AS "Team_Attributes.team_api_id",
  Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id AS "Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id",
  Team.team_long_name AS "Team.team_long_name",
  Team_Attributes.date AS "Team_Attributes.date",
  Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed AS "Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed",
  Team_Attributes.id AS "Team_Attributes.id"
FROM Team_Attributes
LEFT JOIN Team
  ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
grain: Team_Attributes.id  -- one row per Team_Attributes record enriched with team_long_name
views.description: Denormalized view joining Team_Attributes rows to Team canonical names. Keeps each Team_Attributes row separate and preserves date and all raw measures for ranking/filtering.

views.name: matches_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS match_id,
  m.league_id,
  m.season,
  m.date,
  m.home_team_api_id,
  m.away_team_api_id,
  m.home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
views.description: One row per match with core match fields and goals; useful as the base cohort for season, result and league-level analyses.

views.name: league_draws_by_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS match_id,
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  l.name AS league_name,
  m.season AS season,
  m.home_team_goal AS home_team_goal,
  m.away_team_goal AS away_team_goal,
  CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_draw
FROM
  matches_with_scores_and_league AS m
LEFT JOIN
  League AS l
ON
  m.league_id = l.id
views.description: Denormalized match rows joined to their league name and a computed is_draw flag (home_goal = away_goal). Keeps one row per match with league info and draw indicator to support aggregation by league/season.

views.name: league_match_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  l.name AS league_name,
  m.season AS season,
  COUNT(m.id) AS total_matches,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draw_matches
FROM
  Match m
JOIN
  League l
  ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Aggregated counts of matches and draw counts per league and season. Keeps raw counts so callers can apply season filters, ordering and limits.

views.name: player_attributes_high_sprint
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Player_Attributes.id AS id,
  Player_Attributes.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.date AS date,
  Player_Attributes.sprint_speed AS sprint_speed,
  Player_Attributes.acceleration AS acceleration,
  Player_Attributes.stamina AS stamina,
  Player_Attributes.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  Player_Attributes.potential AS potential
FROM Player_Attributes
views.description: Cohort of player_attribute snapshots that record players' physical and technical attributes; useful to filter by time windows and attribute thresholds (e.g., high sprint speed).

views.name: player_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
views.description: Canonical player dimension with stable identifiers and demographic attributes; used to compute ages and join to attribute or match data.

views.name: players_with_high_sprint_in_period
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  P.player_api_id,
  P.player_fifa_api_id,
  P.player_name,
  P.birthday,
  PA.date AS qualifying_snapshot_date,
  PA.sprint_speed,
  PA.overall_rating,
  PA.potential,
  P.id AS player_id,
  PA.id AS player_attributes_id
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA
  ON (P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id AND (P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id OR PA.player_fifa_api_id IS NULL OR P.player_fifa_api_id IS NULL))
WHERE PA.sprint_speed IS NOT NULL
  AND PA.date IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per player per qualifying Player_Attributes snapshot
views.description: Players who have at least one attribute snapshot in a configurable year range meeting configurable attribute thresholds; exposes player identity and the qualifying snapshot(s).

views.name: matches_core_15
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "Match"."id" AS match_id,
  "Match"."league_id" AS league_id,
  "Match"."match_api_id" AS match_api_id,
  "Match"."date" AS date,
  "Match"."season" AS season,
  "Match"."home_team_api_id" AS home_team_api_id,
  "Match"."away_team_api_id" AS away_team_api_id
FROM "Match"
views.description: One-row-per-match core match facts with key foreign ids and basic match identifiers. Keep raw columns useful for filtering, grouping, and counts.

views.name: league_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS league_id,
  League.name AS league_name,
  League.country_id AS country_id
FROM League
views.description: Canonical league dimension: one row per league id with league name and country reference. Useful for joining match facts to readable league names.

views.name: matches_count_by_league
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  league_id,
  COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM
  "Match"
GROUP BY
  league_id
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of matches per league_id. Provides raw match_count per league (no ordering/limit) to support top-k or filtered queries.

views.name: team_attributes_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id,
  Team_Attributes.team_api_id,
  Team_Attributes.date,
  Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed,
  Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassing,
  Team_Attributes.chanceCreationCrossing,
  Team_Attributes.defencePressure,
  Team_Attributes.defenceAggression,
  Team_Attributes.defenceTeamWidth,
  Team_Attributes.id AS team_attributes_id
FROM Team_Attributes
grain: team_attributes.id  -- one row per Team_Attributes record (snapshot)
views.description: Normalized projection of Team_Attributes exposing team identifiers, snapshot date, and core tactical/attribute numeric measures. Keeps raw numeric measures and canonical date for downstream filtering and joins.

views.name: team_attributes_latest_per_team
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ta.team_api_id,
  ta.team_fifa_api_id,
  ta.date,
  ta.buildUpPlaySpeed,
  ta.buildUpPlayPassing,
  ta.chanceCreationCrossing,
  ta.defencePressure,
  ta.defenceAggression,
  ta.defenceTeamWidth
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Team_Attributes
  GROUP BY team_api_id
) AS latest
  ON ta.team_api_id = latest.team_api_id
  AND ta.date = latest.max_date
grain: team_api_id  -- one row per team (latest snapshot)
views.description: Latest Team_Attributes snapshot per team_api_id (most recent date). Useful for questions asking about current/latest team characteristics without needing to pass a date filter each time.

views.name: team_with_metadata
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Team.team_api_id AS "team.team_api_id",
  Team.team_fifa_api_id AS "team.team_fifa_api_id",
  Team.team_long_name AS "team.team_long_name",
  Team.team_short_name AS "team.team_short_name",
  Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id AS "team_attributes.team_fifa_api_id",
  Team_Attributes.date AS "team_attributes.date",
  Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed AS "team_attributes.buildUpPlaySpeed",
  Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassing AS "team_attributes.buildUpPlayPassing",
  Team_Attributes.defencePressure AS "team_attributes.defencePressure",
  Team.id AS team_id,
  Team_Attributes.id AS team_attributes_id
FROM Team
JOIN Team_Attributes
  ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
grain: team.team_api_id + team_attributes.date  -- one row per team snapshot (if latest applied, one row per team)
views.description: Denormalized relation joining Team and Team_Attributes (latest snapshot optional). Exposes team identifiers and human-readable team names alongside attribute measures for easy reporting and filtering.

views.name: team_attributes_annual_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  tar.id AS id,
  tar.team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  tar.team_fifa_api_id AS team_fifa_api_id,
  tar.date AS date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', tar.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  -- expose nulls for buildUpPlayPassing (do not coalesce)
  tar.buildUpPlayPassing AS buildUpPlayPassing,
  tar.buildUpPlayPassingClass AS buildUpPlayPassingClass,
  -- clean numeric attributes: ensure integers (they are stored as INTEGER) and pass through nulls
  tar.buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed,
  tar.buildUpPlaySpeedClass AS buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
  tar.chanceCreationPassing AS chanceCreationPassing,
  tar.chanceCreationPassingClass AS chanceCreationPassingClass,
  tar.defencePressure AS defencePressure,
  tar.defencePressureClass AS defencePressureClass
FROM team_attributes_rows AS tar
grain: Team_Attributes.id (one row per original Team_Attributes record)
views.description: One row per Team_Attributes record with normalized date parts and cleaned numeric attributes, used to form year-based cohorts of team attributes.

views.name: team_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Team.team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  Team.team_fifa_api_id AS team_fifa_api_id,
  Team.team_long_name AS team_long_name,
  Team.team_short_name AS team_short_name,
  Team.id AS id
FROM Team
views.description: Canonical team identity mapping: one row per Team with stable ids and display names used to join attributes to human-readable team names.

views.name: team_attributes_yearly_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%Y', team_attributes_rows.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  COUNT(team_attributes_rows.buildUpPlayPassing) AS count_buildUpPlayPassing,
  SUM(team_attributes_rows.buildUpPlayPassing) AS sum_buildUpPlayPassing,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(team_attributes_rows.buildUpPlayPassing) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE 1.0 * SUM(team_attributes_rows.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(team_attributes_rows.buildUpPlayPassing)
  END AS avg_buildUpPlayPassing
FROM team_attributes_rows
GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%Y', team_attributes_rows.date) AS INTEGER)
views.description: Per-year aggregates for team attributes across all teams (year-level measures), exposing counts and sums for computing averages and distributions without hard-coded year values.

views.name: player_core_24
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  DATE(birthday) AS birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
views.description: Canonical player row with stable identifiers and demographics (one row per player). Normalize birthday to DATE semantics and expose primary ids and name for joins and filtering.

views.name: player_attribute_observations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Player_Attributes.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.date AS date,
  Player_Attributes.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  Player_Attributes.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  Player_Attributes.potential AS potential,
  Player_Attributes.id AS player_attributes_id
FROM Player_Attributes
views.description: All player attribute observations (one row per Player_Attributes record) with canonical columns used for player traits (preferred_foot, ratings, and date of observation). Keep raw values so caller can deduplicate or pick latest observation.

views.name: player_with_attributes_presence
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.birthday,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id OR pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_any_attributes,
  (
    SELECT preferred_foot
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE (pa2.player_api_id = p.player_api_id OR pa2.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id)
      AND pa2.preferred_foot IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY preferred_foot
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, preferred_foot ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS preferred_foot_mode
FROM Player p
views.description: Denormalized relation listing players together with a flag indicating presence of any attribute observations and canonical preferred_foot values when determinable. Useful for counting distinct players who have attribute data and for applying preferred_foot filters per player.

views.name: player_attributes_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.player_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.date,
  Player_Attributes.overall_rating,
  Player_Attributes.potential,
  Player_Attributes.preferred_foot,
  Player_Attributes.long_shots,
  Player_Attributes.dribbling,
  Player_Attributes.short_passing,
  Player_Attributes.shot_power,
  Player_Attributes.stamina,
  Player_Attributes.strength,
  Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes,
  Player_Attributes.id AS player_attributes_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE Player_Attributes.long_shots IS NOT NULL
views.description: Row-level records of player attribute measurements (one row per Player_Attributes record). Keeps original fields and does not aggregate so it can be filtered, averaged or joined later.

views.name: players_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name AS player_name,
  birthday AS birthday,
  height AS height,
  weight AS weight
FROM Player
views.description: Canonical player identifier and basic demographics for use when joining to attribute or match data. One row per Player.

views.name: player_attributes_by_player
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_fifa_api_id,
  COUNT(*) AS count_records,
  AVG(long_shots) AS avg_long_shots,
  AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating,
  AVG(potential) AS avg_potential
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE long_shots IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_fifa_api_id
views.description: Aggregated attribute measures per player_fifa_api_id computed from Player_Attributes rows. Keeps counts and raw aggregated sums/averages to support many player-level metric questions.

views.name: player_core_30
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
views.description: One row per player exposing stable ids and basic demographics used for joining and filtering (name, birthday, height, weight).

views.name: player_attribute_measurements
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Player_Attributes.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  Player_Attributes.date AS date,
  Player_Attributes.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  Player_Attributes.potential AS potential,
  Player_Attributes.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate AS attacking_work_rate,
  Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate AS defensive_work_rate,
  Player_Attributes.crossing AS crossing,
  Player_Attributes.finishing AS finishing,
  Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy AS heading_accuracy,
  Player_Attributes.short_passing AS short_passing,
  Player_Attributes.volleys AS volleys,
  Player_Attributes.dribbling AS dribbling,
  Player_Attributes.long_passing AS long_passing,
  Player_Attributes.ball_control AS ball_control,
  Player_Attributes.acceleration AS acceleration,
  Player_Attributes.sprint_speed AS sprint_speed,
  Player_Attributes.agility AS agility,
  Player_Attributes.reactions AS reactions,
  Player_Attributes.balance AS balance,
  Player_Attributes.shot_power AS shot_power,
  Player_Attributes.stamina AS stamina,
  Player_Attributes.strength AS strength,
  Player_Attributes.interceptions AS interceptions,
  Player_Attributes.positioning AS positioning,
  Player_Attributes.vision AS vision,
  Player_Attributes.penalties AS penalties,
  Player_Attributes.marking AS marking,
  Player_Attributes.standing_tackle AS standing_tackle,
  Player_Attributes.sliding_tackle AS sliding_tackle,
  Player_Attributes.gk_diving AS gk_diving,
  Player_Attributes.gk_handling AS gk_handling,
  Player_Attributes.gk_kicking AS gk_kicking,
  Player_Attributes.gk_positioning AS gk_positioning,
  Player_Attributes.gk_reflexes AS gk_reflexes,
  Player_Attributes.id AS id
FROM Player_Attributes
views.description: Raw attribute records for players; one row per Player_Attributes record with attribute fields kept raw and NULLs preserved so downstream queries can exclude them as needed.

views.name: player_heading_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(heading_accuracy,0)) AS heading_accuracy_sum,
  COUNT(heading_accuracy) AS heading_accuracy_count,
  MIN(date) AS first_attribute_date,
  MAX(date) AS last_attribute_date
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id
HAVING COUNT(heading_accuracy) >= 0
views.description: Per-player aggregated heading measure computed from Player_Attributes; exposes counts and sums so averages can be computed; keeps both player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id keys for flexible joins.

views.name: matches_core_33
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id" AS match_id,
  "league_id" AS league_id,
  "season" AS season,
  "date" AS date,
  "home_team_api_id" AS home_team_api_id,
  "away_team_api_id" AS away_team_api_id,
  "home_team_goal" AS home_team_goal,
  "away_team_goal" AS away_team_goal
FROM "Match"
views.description: Row-level match records with key identifiers and primary match stats (goals, teams, league, season, date). Useful as the basic cohort of matches to filter, join and aggregate for season- or league-level analyses.

views.name: league_basic_34
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS league_id,
  League.name AS league_name,
  League.country_id AS country_id
FROM League
views.description: Canonical league table exposing league id and name (one row per league). Useful to join human-readable league attributes to aggregated match results.

views.name: league_match_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.league_id AS league_id,
  m.season AS season,
  COUNT(m.id) AS matches_count,
  AVG(CAST(m.home_team_goal AS REAL)) AS avg_home_team_goal,
  AVG(CAST(m.away_team_goal AS REAL)) AS avg_away_team_goal,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal,0)) AS total_home_goals,
  SUM(COALESCE(m.away_team_goal,0)) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match m
GROUP BY
  m.league_id,
  m.season
views.description: Aggregated match measures per league and season: counts and average goals (home and away). Generalized to support comparisons across seasons or leagues.

views.name: player_core_36
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_api_id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_name,
  birthday,
  height,
  weight,
  id
FROM Player
WHERE birthday IS NOT NULL
views.description: Normalized player identity and basic attributes with canonical columns for joins and filtering. One row per player as recorded in the Player table. Keeps raw birthday string for downstream date filtering and exposes identifiers and name.

views.name: player_birth_year_month
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_api_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name,
  p.birthday,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birthday IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p.birthday)) >= 4 THEN substr(p.birthday, 1, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birthday IS NOT NULL AND instr(substr(p.birthday, 6, 2), '') <> 0 AND length(trim(p.birthday)) >= 7 THEN substr(p.birthday, 6, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_month
FROM Player p
WHERE p.birthday IS NOT NULL
views.description: Cohort view exposing parsed year and month from player birthday for easy temporal filtering and grouping. Keeps original birthday and derived year/month strings to avoid repeated substr calls.

views.name: player_attributes_snapshot
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  p.player_name AS player_name,
  p.birthday AS birthday,
  pa.date AS attribute_date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  pa.attacking_work_rate AS attacking_work_rate,
  pa.defensive_work_rate AS defensive_work_rate,
  pa.crossing AS crossing,
  pa.finishing AS finishing,
  pa.dribbling AS dribbling,
  pa.short_passing AS short_passing,
  pa.long_passing AS long_passing,
  pa.ball_control AS ball_control,
  pa.acceleration AS acceleration,
  pa.sprint_speed AS sprint_speed,
  pa.stamina AS stamina,
  pa.strength AS strength,
  pa.id AS player_attributes_id,
  p.id AS player_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per player_api_id per Player_Attributes.id (attribute snapshot)
views.description: Denormalized relation joining Player with Player_Attributes to expose player attribute measures alongside player identity. Useful for filtering players by attributes or joining attribute-derived cohorts with player metadata. Does not pick a specific date -- returns all attribute records per player to allow latest-per-player selection in downstream queries.

views.name: player_attributes_by_player_date
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  pa.attacking_work_rate AS attacking_work_rate,
  pa.defensive_work_rate AS defensive_work_rate,
  pa.id AS player_attributes_id

views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.player_api_id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.date,
  pa.id,
  pa.overall_rating,
  pa.potential,
  pa.volleys,
  pa.dribbling,
  pa.crossing,
  pa.finishing,
  pa.short_passing,
  pa.ball_control,
  pa.acceleration,
  pa.sprint_speed,
  pa.agility,
  pa.strength,
  pa.stamina,
  pa.gk_diving,
  pa.gk_handling,
  pa.gk_kicking,
  pa.gk_positioning,
  pa.gk_reflexes,
  -- rank per player_api_id where 1 = latest (most recent date)
  (SELECT COUNT(1)
   FROM Player_Attributes pa2

     AND (pa2.date > pa.date OR (pa2.date = pa.date AND pa2.id >= pa.id))

FROM Player_Attributes pa
output_columns: row_rank  -- integer rank where 1 is latest
